QUOTE: If `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_NO_STD_FUNCTIONS` is set, they become stubs instead: calloc returns NULL and free does nothing (`platform.c:25-42`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that with no standard functions, the default pointers are stubs where calloc returns NULL and free does nothing, i.e. they fail rather than fall back.
